speaker: Doctor
text: I see you are experiencing fatigue, flank pain, and fever following recent antibiotic treatment for acute sinusitis. To better understand your condition, please tell me how many days you had the sinusitis symptoms before starting the antibiotics, and what specific antibiotic was prescribed?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis.

The progression of fever, fatigue, and new flank pain after sinusitis treatment is classic for a post-infectious urinary tract infection that has ascended to the kidneys. I will need to confirm this with imaging or lab work, but clinically this fits the picture of renal infection.

REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis.
REQUEST TEST: Urine_Culture.
REQUEST IMAGES: Renal_Ultrasound.
